<sup>a</sup></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (cmp. b. h. מְאוּרָה) 
<italic>hollow, cavity of a vessel.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. II, 1 מיתטמאין ומטמאין בא' become unclean and make unclean by contact with the hollow (of the vessel).—Yeb. 67
<sup>b</sup> נפק לא' העולם came forth into the lighted space of the world, i.e. was born; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (cmp. ἀήρ, aër) 
<italic>air, atmosphere, climate, weather</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 14 הא' שממנו וכ' (as one of the elements of nature) out of which the wind was made.—Gen. R. s. 34 א' יפה 
<italic>fine weather</italic>; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. אֲוִירִין</plural-form>
<italic>blank spaces in writings</italic>. B. Bath. 163
<sup>a</sup>.—אֲוִירוֹת 
<italic>climates</italic>. Gen. R. s. 34 ברית נחלקה לא' a covenant has been made in favor of climates, i.e. God has implanted in man a love of his native soil even in bad climates.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<notes>; = אוּנְקַי; corresp. to b. h. לוּלַי; Greek adapt. ἀγκολη, LXX Ex. XXVI, 10; cmp. אוֹנִי as to contact of the two languages) prop. 
<italic>little</italic> (
<italic>camel’s</italic>) 
<italic>neck</italic>, hence </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>hook, rack.</italic></definition>
<notes> Kel. XII, 2 א' של כתפין Ar. (ed. אונקליות, אונקלין with adject. in the sing., corr. acc.) the carriers’ hook attached to their yoke, pole &c. Ib. א' של דרגש the hook of the bedstead (used for fastening the girths to the posts); של נקליטין the rack of the bed-curtain, v. נַקְלִיטִין. Ib. 3 א' שבכותלים hook attached to walls.—T’bul Yom IV, 6 ואנ' שלהם קיימת and the hook (attached to the now broken yoke) remained unimpaired; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. אוּנְקְלָאוֹת, אָנְקְ',</plural-form> (אונקלין) אוּנְקְלִיּוֹת. Tam. III, 5; Mid. III, 5; a. fr.—Kel. l. c.; Tosef. ib. B. Mets. II, 4; v. אוּנְקַי.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> [cmp. ἀγκαλίς in S.] 
<italic>the load carried on the hook, the farmer’s load of sheaves or bunches;</italic> cmp. בלונקי.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Maas. Sh. IV, 10. כל הא' the whole load. [Ib. 11 אונקולין, אונקלי, read with ed. Zuck. אינפולי].</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> Trnsf. (medic.) 
<italic>bent cartilage</italic>, esp. 
<italic>the cartilage</italic> (cart. ensiformis) 
<italic>at the end of the sternum which, being bent inside, presses on the stomach and creates nausea</italic> &c. Ab. Zar. 29
<sup>a</sup> מעלין א' וכ' you are permitted to lift the cartilage on the Sabbath (by means of a bandage &c.).</definition>
<notes> Ib. מאי א' וכ' what 
<italic>unklay</italic> is meant? Ans. the cartilage in front of the heart; v. אִיסְתּוֹמְכָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
